table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = service.name,
	servicecategory=(select name from servicecategory where servicecategory.servicecatcode=service.servicecatcode), 
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	reprintcount = 0,
	dbo.serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode,   
	dbo.serviceRheader.date,  
	dbo.serviceRheader.headerno, 
	dbo.serviceRheader.discperc,  
	dbo.serviceRheader.flatdisc,	 
	dbo.serviceRheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceRheader.custcode,   
	dbo.serviceRheader.remarks,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=servicerheader.doctcode),   
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.serviceRdetail.Serviceprice, 
	ServiceFlatDisc = ServiceRDetail.ServiceFlatDisc,
	Qty = dbo.serviceRdetail.qty,
	servicedetail_discperc = dbo.serviceRdetail.discperc, 
	patient.regno,
	patient=patient.name,
	patientageyears=patient.ageyears,
	patientagemonts=patient.agemonths,
	patientagedays=patient.agedays,
	patientgender=(case patient.gender when 'M' then 'Male' else 'Female' end),
	serviceRTotal=dbo.fn_getServiceReturnInvTotal(serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode)

	
	
FROM 
	dbo.serviceRheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.serviceRheader.patientcode = patient.patientcode),    
	dbo.serviceRdetail,  
	service, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = dbo.serviceRdetail.serviceRinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceRheader.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceRheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( serviceRdetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )  
	
Order by
	dbo.ServiceRDetail.SrvRRowid
